meta.name: xata
meta.description: Load when working with Xata Postgres branches: forking a branch, building or testing dbt models on a branch, wiring dbt to a branch's credentials, diffing two branches, or the pre-merge impact report. Covers create_xata_branch, delete_xata_branch, get_dbt_profile, xata_branch_diff, schema_diff_branches, and pgroll migrations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Xata Postgres 分支与 dbt 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Xata 做数据库分支和 dbt 数据建模
copy.tagline_en: Manage Xata Postgres branches and dbt models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Xata for database branching and dbt data modeling

howto.what: Claude 可以管理 Xata Postgres 分支：创建或删除分支、为 dbt 配置分支凭证、比较两个分支的差异并生成 HTML 报告，以及处理 pgroll 迁移。
howto.when: 当用户需要操作 Xata 分支（如创建、删除、配置 dbt、比较分支、生成合并前报告）时触发。

say.text: 给分支 feature_branch 获取 dbt 配置文件，目标名为 dev。
say.note: 返回一个 shell 命令，需在 dbt 项目目录中运行。

howto.what_en: Claude can manage Xata Postgres branches: create or delete branches, configure dbt profiles for a branch, diff two branches and generate HTML reports, and handle pgroll migrations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to work with Xata branches, such as forking, deleting, wiring dbt, diffing branches, or running pre-merge impact reports.

say_en.text: Create a branch named agent_model_20250301 forked from staging.
say_en.note: Will create the branch and return confirmation.

say_en.text: Get dbt profile for branch feature_branch with target dev.
say_en.note: Returns a shell command to run in the dbt project directory.

say_en.text: Diff staging and feature_branch and generate an HTML report.
